_description: Extension schema for r/covidlonghaulers. Adds 3 COVID-specific extension fields on top of the universal base set.
_changes_from_v1: alternative_treatments and social_impact were promoted to base fields, so include_base_fields is now empty. functional_status_tier was promoted to base as well and is no longer redefined here.

infection_count.description: Number of separate COVID infections, as a bare integer ('1', '2', '3'). EXACT COUNTS ONLY - the number must be recoverable from what the patient wrote. 'my second infection' -> '2'; 'infected three times' -> '3'; 'my first infection', or one infection described with no mention of others -> '1'. Wording that establishes only a lower bound gives NO value - 'reinfected', 'got it again', 'multiple infections', 'several times' all -> null, because none of them says how many. That a reinfection happened is still captured by onset_trigger and prior_infections; this field is a count, and a lower bound recorded as a count would be read downstream as exact.

long_covid_duration_months.description: How long the patient has had Long COVID specifically, as a bare integer NUMBER OF MONTHS. Convert stated durations: '3 years' -> '36', '18 months' -> '18', 'a year and a half' -> '18'. Converting an explicitly stated duration is required and is not inference; inventing a duration the patient never gave is. A date with no stated duration ('sick since March 2020') gives no value - use null. This field is Long COVID specifically; whole-illness duration belongs in illness_duration, which keeps the patient's own wording.

biomarker_results.description: Named test or biomarker with its stated result, formatted 'test: result' - for example 'ANA: positive', 'ferritin: 12 ng/mL', 'D-dimer: elevated', 'MCAS panel: normal', 'vitamin D: low'. Keep any stated number and unit in the result. A test named with no result ('had bloodwork done') and a result with no test ('my levels were low') are both unusable - use null. Do not restate diagnoses here; those belong in conditions.
